newsitem.title: IRAN: Iranian police kill three smugglers, seize drugs.
newsitem.headline: Iranian police kill three smugglers, seize drugs.

text.p: Police in northeastern Iran have killed three armed smugglers and seized 1.2 tonnes of opium, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Wednesday.
It quoted a senior police official in Khorasan provice on the border with Afghanistan as saying 33 drug traffickers were also arrested during the three-day operation.
Iran said on Tuesday anti-narcotics squads seized 500 kg (1,100 lbs) of opium from smugglers in a neighbouring province.
Iran's eastern provinces bordering Afghanistan and Pakistan are a major route for drugs smuggling of opium, from which heroin in made, to Europe via Turkey.
Iran publicly hanged 12 convicted drugs smugglers in Khorasan's capital city of Mashhad, a newspaper said on Monday.
More than 1,000 people have been executed in Iran since a 1989 law took effect imposing the death sentence for possession of five kg (11 lbs) of opium or 30 grams (just over one ounce) of heroin.
